# Floating Point Approximate Comparison Recipe
import pytest
def test_floating_point_precision():
    # Uses pytest.approx to handle IEEE 754 precision inaccuracies
    result = calculate_discount(100.0)
    assert result == pytest.approx(90.0, rel=1e-3, abs=1e-4)

# Boundary Testing for Relational Threshold Off-By-One Inversions
import pytest
def test_boundary_threshold_triplet():
    # Evaluates exact threshold boundary T and adjacent neighbors T-1, T, T+1
    # Prevents '<' vs '<=' and '>' vs '>=' boundary escapes
    assert check_threshold(99) is False
    assert check_threshold(100) is True
